name: Ollama Inc.
one_liner: Makes Ollama, the most popular open-source runtime and CLI for downloading and running open LLMs.
local_ai_angle: One-command local model serving with OpenAI-compatible API on Mac/Windows/Linux; ~9M developers.

name: Element Labs
one_liner: Makes LM Studio desktop app and Locally mobile app for discovering and running local LLMs.

name: Menlo Research

name: Nomic AI
